scenario: 一个疫情前训练好的 Airbnb 排序模型，用户想找偏远小屋，它却一直推市区公寓——世界变了、模型没变。
scenario_en: A pre-pandemic Airbnb ranker keeps surfacing urban apartments while users now want remote cabins — the world moved, the model stood still.
q: ML 系统的「反馈回路 (feedback loop)」指什么，为什么它既是改进引擎又是危险来源？
q_en: What is an ML feedback loop, and why is it both the engine of improvement and a source of danger?
why: 回路是「预测→用户行为(点击/购买/跳过)→标签→未来训练」的闭环：它让模型持续吸收新反馈变好，但也会把偏差和被操纵的信号一起放大喂回去，导致质量悄悄退化。
why_en: The loop is predictions to user actions to labels to future training, which keeps improving the model but can also amplify bias and gamed signals back into it.
diagram:
flowchart LR P["模型预测"] --> A["用户行为
点击/购买/跳过"] A --> L["生成标签"] L --> T["未来训练"] T --> P
options: 回路是指模型上线后固定不变、只服务不学习，所以既稳定又安全，不会退化
回路是「预测→用户行为→标签→未来训练」的闭环：既持续改进模型，也会放大偏差/被操纵信号导致悄悄退化
回路只是监控指标的采集通道，跟模型训练无关，风险只在于采集延迟
回路指的是多个模型互相调用的服务依赖图，危险来自级联超时
options_en: The loop means the model is frozen after deployment and only serves, so it is stable and safe and never degrades.
The loop is predictions to user actions to labels to future training, which both improves the model and amplifies bias or gamed signals into silent decay.
The loop is just a metrics-collection channel unrelated to training, and its only risk is collection latency.
The loop refers to the service dependency graph of models calling each other, with danger from cascading timeouts.
optionExplanations: 冻结模型正是本课要治的病：世界会漂移，不学习的模型会像疫情前的 Airbnb 排序一样慢慢失准。
对；这条闭环既是持续学习的引擎，也是把噪声、操纵和历史偏差喂回模型的通道，所以要既用它又防它。
回路的核心恰恰是训练——用户行为回流成标签驱动再训练，不只是被动采集监控数据。
混淆了概念：这里说的是数据/标签的时间闭环，不是服务调用拓扑，危险来自数据而非超时。
optionExplanations_en: A frozen model is exactly the disease this lesson treats: the world drifts and a non-learning model slowly goes stale like the pre-pandemic Airbnb ranker.
Correct — this closed loop is both the engine of continual learning and the channel that feeds noise, manipulation, and historical bias back in, so you both use it and guard it.
The core of the loop is training: user actions flow back as labels that drive retraining, not just passive metric collection.
This confuses concepts: the loop is a data/label time cycle, not a service call topology, and the danger is data, not timeouts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测→用户行为→标签→再训练的闭环，模型用自己影响过的数据继续学习。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feedback loop is the cycle of predictions to user actions to labels to retraining, where the model keeps learning from data it itself influenced.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上输入或行为随时间变化，训练时的分布与现在服务看到的分布不再一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distribution shift is when live inputs or behavior change over time so the training distribution no longer matches what the model now sees at serving.

scenario: 广告 CTR 预估：点击信号几秒内回流、特征 schema 稳定、单次坏更新影响面有限，热门查询几分钟内就冒出来。
scenario_en: Ad CTR prediction: click signals arrive within seconds, the feature schema is stable, a single bad update is bounded, and trending queries appear within minutes.
q: 这种任务最适合哪种学习方式？
q_en: Which learning approach best fits this task?
why: 在线学习让模型即时吸收每条新样本、几分钟内追上热门趋势，前提正是本场景满足的三条：标签回流快、特征空间稳定、单次坏更新影响面有界。
why_en: Online learning absorbs each new example immediately and catches trends within minutes, which fits precisely because labels arrive fast, the feature space is stable, and a bad update is bounded.
tradeoff: 在线学习(即时适应但易受噪声/操纵) vs 批量再训练(稳但有小时级滞后)
options: 在线学习：即时吸收点击信号、分钟级追上趋势，正好匹配标签快+特征稳+影响面有界
只做季度批量再训练，保证稳定，趋势滞后几个月也可接受
完全不训练，靠人工每天调规则应对趋势变化
只用离线 A/B 实验结果手动更新权重，不接入实时信号
options_en: Online learning: absorb click signals immediately and catch trends within minutes, matching fast labels plus stable features plus bounded blast radius.
Quarterly batch retraining only, for stability, accepting trend lag of several months.
No training at all, relying on humans to hand-tune rules daily for trend changes.
Manually update weights only from offline A/B results, with no real-time signal.
whenOtherWins: 若标签要 90 天才确认(如贷款违约)、或特征 schema 频繁变动，即时更新会放大噪声，改用批量/周期再训练更稳。
optionExplanations: 对；三条前提(标签快、特征稳、影响面有界)全满足，在线学习的即时适应收益最大、风险最小。
季度再训练对 CTR 太慢，热门查询几分钟就变，几个月滞后等于把广告收益拱手让人。
人工调规则扛不住广告规模和分钟级变化，无法学习细粒度的点击模式。
只靠离线 A/B 手动更新既慢又不实时，浪费了 CTR 场景秒级回流的快标签优势。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — with all three preconditions met (fast labels, stable features, bounded blast radius), online learning's immediate adaptation gives the most upside at least risk.
Quarterly retraining is far too slow for CTR: trending queries shift in minutes, and months of lag hands ad revenue to competitors.
Hand-tuned rules cannot cope with ad-scale traffic and minute-level change, and cannot learn fine-grained click patterns.
Manual offline A/B updates are slow and non-real-time, wasting the second-level fast labels that CTR offers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型逐条吸收新样本并即时调整权重，而不是攒一批离线再训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Online learning updates the model's weights on each new example immediately rather than retraining in offline batches.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率：展示后被点击的比例，是广告排序的核心预估目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of impressions that get clicked, a core prediction target in ad ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次坏更新最多能波及的流量或用户范围，越小越敢频繁更新。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blast radius is how much traffic or how many users a single bad update can affect; smaller means safer to update often.

scenario: 对比在线学习和批量再训练在「噪声」这一维度上的表现。
scenario_en: Compare online learning and batch retraining on the single dimension of noise handling.
q: 在「抗噪声」这一维度上，在线学习相对批量再训练的关键差别是什么？
q_en: On noise robustness, what is the key difference between online learning and batch retraining?
why: 批量再训练在一整批数据上求平均，会把个别噪声/坏标签摊薄；在线学习逐条更新，一批被污染的标签能在没人察觉前就改变模型行为。
why_en: Batch retraining averages over a whole batch and dilutes stray noise, while online learning updates example by example so one corrupted label batch can shift behavior before anyone notices.
tradeoff: 批量(求平均、抗噪但滞后) vs 在线(即时但一批坏标签立刻改变行为)
options: 在线学习天生比批量更抗噪，因为它样本多
两者抗噪能力相同，差别只在训练速度
批量对整批求平均摊薄噪声；在线逐条更新，一批坏标签可在无人察觉前改变行为
批量完全免疫噪声，在线则会把每条噪声永久写进权重不可恢复
options_en: Online learning is inherently more noise-robust than batch because it sees more samples.
The two are equally noise-robust; the only difference is training speed.
Batch averages over the whole batch and dilutes noise, while online updates example by example so a bad label batch can shift behavior before anyone notices.
Batch is completely immune to noise while online writes every noisy example permanently and irrecoverably into weights.
optionExplanations: 说反了：批量的「求平均」才是抗噪来源，在线逐条更新恰恰更易被单批噪声带偏。
抗噪能力并不相同——平均 vs 逐条更新造成本质差异，不只是速度问题。
对；这正是在线学习「不稳定」风险的机制：批量摊薄、在线放大单批噪声。
过度绝对：批量并非免疫噪声，在线的坏更新也能靠后续正确样本或回滚修正，不是永久不可恢复。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: batch's averaging is the source of noise robustness, while online's per-example updates are more easily pulled off course by a single noisy batch.
They are not equally robust — averaging versus per-example updates is a fundamental difference, not just speed.
Correct — this is exactly the mechanism of online learning's instability risk: batch dilutes, online amplifies a single noisy batch.
Overstated: batch is not immune, and an online bad update can be corrected by later correct samples or a rollback, not permanently irrecoverable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 攒一段时间的数据后统一离线训练一版新模型，周期是小时到天。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Batch retraining accumulates data over a period and trains a new model offline, on an hours-to-days cadence.

scenario: 上线在线学习后，一批黑产账号持续注入伪造点击，专门给某类低质内容刷互动。
scenario_en: After enabling online learning, bad actors continuously inject synthetic clicks to boost engagement on a class of low-quality content.
q: 这会触发在线学习的哪个风险，后果链是什么？
q_en: Which online-learning risk does this trigger, and what is the consequence chain?
why: 这是「反馈回路被操纵(gaming)」：伪造点击→模型即时学到该内容受欢迎→加大曝光→吸引更多伪造点击，形成自我强化的欺诈放大环，需要异常检测/信号过滤来打断。
why_en: This is feedback-loop gaming: fake clicks make the model instantly learn the content is popular, boost its exposure, and attract more fake clicks in a self-reinforcing fraud loop that needs anomaly filtering to break.
options: 只是短暂噪声，模型会自动忽略，无需处理
反馈回路被操纵：伪造点击→即时学到受欢迎→加大曝光→吸引更多伪造点击，自我强化，需信号过滤打断
属于基础设施复杂度问题，加机器扩容即可解决
属于训练-服务偏差，用统一特征仓库即可消除
options_en: Just transient noise the model will auto-ignore, no action needed.
Feedback-loop gaming: fake clicks make it learn 'popular', boost exposure, attract more fake clicks, self-reinforcing, needing signal filtering to break.
An infrastructure-complexity problem solvable by adding more machines.
Training-serving skew, eliminated by a unified feature store.
optionExplanations: 模型不会自动忽略——在线学习即时把伪造点击当真实偏好学进去，正是它放大欺诈的原因。
对；这条自我强化环是在线学习特有的 gaming 风险，光靠再训练修不了，得在信号入口做异常检测和过滤。
扩容解决不了信号被污染的问题；这是数据可信度问题，不是算力瓶颈。
训练-服务偏差是特征计算不一致，与恶意注入点击的操纵不是一回事。
optionExplanations_en: The model will not auto-ignore it — online learning instantly treats fake clicks as real preference, which is exactly how it amplifies the fraud.
Correct — this self-reinforcing loop is online learning's signature gaming risk; retraining alone cannot fix it, you need anomaly detection and filtering at the signal intake.
Adding machines does not fix polluted signal; this is a data-trust problem, not a compute bottleneck.
Training-serving skew is inconsistent feature computation, which is a different problem from malicious injected clicks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 外部行为者注入伪造信号，让模型放大他们想推的内容，形成自我强化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feedback-loop gaming is when actors inject fake signals so the model amplifies the content they want, in a self-reinforcing loop.

scenario: 团队想给某任务上在线学习，先评估这个任务到底适不适合。
scenario_en: A team wants online learning for a task and first assesses whether the task is even suitable.
q: 满足哪些条件时在线学习才可行？(多选)
q_en: Which conditions make online learning viable? (multiple)
why: 在线学习可行的三条：标签回流快(点击而非 90 天违约)、特征空间稳定(无 schema 频繁变动)、单次坏更新影响面有界。三者缺一，即时更新的风险就压过收益。
why_en: Online learning is viable when labels arrive fast (clicks, not 90-day defaults), the feature space is stable (no schema churn), and a single bad update is bounded; miss any one and the risk of instant updates outweighs the benefit.
options: 标签回流快(如点击，而非 90 天后才确认的贷款违约)
特征空间稳定，没有频繁的 schema 变动
单次坏更新的影响面有界，能限制爆炸半径
有大量离线历史数据可供一次性预训练
options_en: Labels arrive fast (clicks, not loan defaults confirmed after 90 days).
The feature space is stable with no frequent schema churn.
A single bad update's blast radius is bounded and can be contained.
There is lots of offline historical data available for a one-time pretrain.
optionExplanations: 对；标签越快回流，在线学习越能即时纠偏；90 天才确认的标签没法支撑即时更新。
对；schema 频繁变动会让在线更新学到不一致的特征，稳定特征空间是前提。
对；影响面有界才敢即时上线，坏更新不至于波及全量用户。
错；有离线历史数据只支持批量预训练，不是在线学习是否可行的判据。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the faster labels return, the sooner online learning can self-correct; labels confirmed after 90 days cannot support instant updates.
Correct — frequent schema churn makes online updates learn inconsistent features, so a stable feature space is a precondition.
Correct — a bounded blast radius is what makes instant deployment safe, so a bad update cannot reach all users.
Wrong — having offline history only supports batch pretraining and is not a criterion for online-learning viability.

termDefinitions.term: schema churn / schema 频繁变动
termDefinitions.meaning: 特征的字段/格式经常增删改，会破坏训练与服务的一致性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Schema churn is frequent changes to feature fields or formats, which breaks consistency between training and serving.

scenario: 一家 MAANG 公司既想要在线学习的即时性，又怕一次坏更新拖垮整个推荐系统。
scenario_en: A MAANG company wants online learning's immediacy but fears one bad update taking down the whole recommender.
q: 他们通常怎么在系统里放置在线学习，以限制爆炸半径？
q_en: How do they typically place online learning in the system to bound the blast radius?
why: 选择性使用：只让最终排序层做在线学习(改动局部、易回滚)，上游候选生成等重模块走周期性再训练，这样一次坏更新只影响排序而不波及整条管线。
why_en: Use it selectively: put online learning only on the final ranking layer (local, easy to roll back) while upstream candidate generation stays on periodic retraining, so a bad update touches only ranking, not the whole pipeline.
tradeoff: 只在线最终排序层(即时且影响面有界) vs 全链路在线(更即时但坏更新波及全系统)
options: 整条管线全部改成在线学习，追求最大即时性
上游候选生成在线、最终排序层走批量，把稳定性放在最后一层
全部离线批量，彻底放弃在线学习
只让最终排序层在线学习、上游走周期性再训练，把爆炸半径圈在排序层
options_en: Convert the entire pipeline to online learning for maximum immediacy.
Make upstream candidate generation online and the final ranking layer batch, putting stability in the last layer.
Everything offline batch, abandoning online learning entirely.
Make only the final ranking layer online and keep upstream on periodic retraining, boxing the blast radius into ranking.
whenOtherWins: 若上游候选生成本身也要秒级追热点(如突发新闻检索)，可给它加一个受控的实时侧路，但仍需与主索引隔离以限风险。
optionExplanations: 全链路在线把爆炸半径拉到最大，一次坏更新能同时污染检索和排序，与他们的目标相反。
顺序搞反：候选生成是重、影响面大的上游，最不该做在线；即时性应放在末端排序。
全离线放弃了即时性，与「既要在线又要限风险」的目标不符。
对；末端排序改动局部、易回滚，在线放这里既得即时性又把风险圈住，是 MAANG 常见做法。
optionExplanations_en: Whole-pipeline online maximizes the blast radius; one bad update can poison both retrieval and ranking, the opposite of their goal.
Order reversed: candidate generation is the heavy, wide-impact upstream that should least be online; immediacy belongs at the ranking tail.
Fully offline abandons immediacy, contradicting the goal of wanting online plus bounded risk.
Correct — the tail ranker is local and easy to roll back, so putting online there gains immediacy while boxing the risk, a common MAANG pattern.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两阶段推荐的第一阶段，从海量目录快速筛出几百个候选交给排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Candidate generation is the first stage of a two-stage recommender, quickly narrowing a huge catalog to a few hundred candidates for ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: Meta/Apple/Amazon/Netflix/Google 等大型科技公司的统称。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MAANG refers to large tech companies like Meta, Apple, Amazon, Netflix, and Google.

scenario: 要真正把在线学习跑起来，评估它对基础设施的额外要求。
scenario_en: To actually run online learning, assess the extra infrastructure it demands.
q: 在线学习需要哪些基础设施能力？(多选)
q_en: Which infrastructure capabilities does online learning require? (multiple)
why: 在线学习是重基建活：需要低延迟特征管线、把预测与真实结果实时对齐的流式标签拼接器(streaming label joiner)、以及能热切换的服务权重。这些复杂度正是它「基础设施复杂」风险的来源。
why_en: Online learning is infrastructure-heavy: it needs a low-latency feature pipeline, a streaming label joiner that matches predictions to outcomes in real time, and hot-swappable serving weights.
options: 低延迟的实时特征管线
流式标签拼接器：实时把预测和它对应的真实结果对齐
可热切换(hot-swap)的服务端权重
一个季度一次的离线批处理调度器就足够
options_en: A low-latency real-time feature pipeline.
A streaming label joiner that matches predictions to their real outcomes in real time.
Hot-swappable serving weights.
A once-per-quarter offline batch scheduler is enough.
optionExplanations: 对；即时更新要求特征也能低延迟供给，否则更新拿不到最新输入。
对；只有把预测与其真实结果实时配对，才能马上算出这次预测对不对来更新。
对；权重要能不停机热切换，才能把学到的即时反映到线上服务。
错；季度批处理正是在线学习要替代的东西，无法支撑即时更新。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — instant updates require features supplied with low latency, or the update lacks the latest inputs.
Correct — only by pairing each prediction with its real outcome in real time can you immediately score it and update.
Correct — weights must hot-swap without downtime so learned changes reach live serving immediately.
Wrong — quarterly batch is exactly what online learning replaces and cannot support instant updates.

termDefinitions.term: streaming label joiner / 流式标签拼接器
termDefinitions.meaning: 把每次预测和它随后到来的真实结果(点击/购买)实时配对成训练样本的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A streaming label joiner pairs each prediction with its later real outcome (click/purchase) in real time to form a training example.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不停机就把线上模型权重替换成新版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hot-swap replaces the live model's weights with a new version without downtime.

scenario: 两种周期性再训练策略：一种按固定节奏跑，一种盯着漂移信号、越阈值才跑。
scenario_en: Two periodic retraining policies: one runs on a fixed cadence, the other watches a drift signal and only retrains when it breaches a threshold.
q: 在「响应实际退化」这一维度上，调度式(scheduled)与触发式(trigger-based)再训练的核心差别是什么？
q_en: On responsiveness to actual degradation, what is the core difference between scheduled and trigger-based retraining?
why: 调度式按固定节奏跑、不看信号，稳定漂移下够用但对突变反应慢；触发式监控漂移信号、越阈值才训，能对真实退化即时响应并在平稳期省算力，代价是需要一套可靠的监控栈。
why_en: Scheduled runs on a fixed cadence blind to signals — fine for gradual drift but slow to sudden shifts — while trigger-based watches a drift signal and retrains on breach, responding to real degradation and saving compute when stable, at the cost of a robust monitoring stack.
tradeoff: 调度式(简单可预测但过训/滞后) vs 触发式(响应真实退化、省算力但依赖监控栈)
options: 调度式能对突变即时响应，触发式反而滞后
调度式按固定节奏、不看信号(对突变慢)；触发式盯漂移越阈值才训、即时响应但需可靠监控栈
两者都需要监控栈，区别只在跑得多频繁
触发式成本永远比调度式低，没有任何代价
options_en: Scheduled responds instantly to sudden shifts while trigger-based lags.
Scheduled runs on a fixed cadence blind to signals (slow to sudden shifts); trigger-based retrains on a drift threshold breach, responding instantly but needing a robust monitoring stack.
Both need a monitoring stack; the only difference is how often they run.
Trigger-based is always cheaper than scheduled with no cost at all.
optionExplanations: 说反了：调度式不看信号，对突变最迟钝；即时响应突变正是触发式的强项。
对；这条差别决定选型——稳定渐进漂移用调度式够，突变高风险场景要触发式即时响应。
调度式并不需要监控栈，这正是它简单的原因；触发式才依赖监控。
触发式省算力但有代价：需要维护一套可靠监控，误报浪费、漏报退化。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: scheduled ignores signals and is slowest to sudden shifts; instant response is trigger-based's strength.
Correct — this difference drives the choice: gradual drift is fine with scheduled, while sudden high-stakes shifts need trigger-based's instant response.
Scheduled does not need a monitoring stack, which is why it is simple; only trigger-based depends on monitoring.
Trigger-based saves compute but has a cost: maintaining a robust monitor, where false alarms waste and missed triggers let degradation slip.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量线上数据或指标偏离训练分布程度的监控量，越阈值即触发再训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A drift signal is a monitored measure of how far live data or metrics deviate from the training distribution, triggering retraining on breach.

scenario: 一个网页搜索排序模型，领域相对稳定、漂移是缓慢渐进的，团队想要可预测的算力开销和编排。
scenario_en: A web-search ranker in a relatively stable domain with slow gradual drift; the team wants predictable compute and orchestration.
q: 该选哪种再训练策略？
q_en: Which retraining policy should you pick?
why: 稳定域+渐进漂移下，调度式(如每日/每周固定再训练)最省心：算力和编排可预测，渐进漂移用固定节奏就能追上，不必为它维护一整套触发监控。
why_en: For a stable domain with gradual drift, scheduled retraining (e.g. daily/weekly) is simplest: compute and orchestration are predictable and a fixed cadence keeps up with slow drift without maintaining trigger monitoring.
tradeoff: 调度式(可预测、够追渐进漂移) vs 触发式(应对突变但要养监控栈)
options: 调度式：固定节奏再训练，算力可预测，渐进漂移用固定周期就能追上
触发式：为渐进漂移专门养一套漂移监控，越阈值才训
在线学习：逐条即时更新排序权重
永不再训练，靠人工每周改规则
options_en: Scheduled: retrain on a fixed cadence, predictable compute, a fixed period keeps up with gradual drift.
Trigger-based: maintain drift monitoring just for gradual drift and retrain on breach.
Online learning: update ranking weights instantly example by example.
Never retrain, hand-editing rules weekly.
whenOtherWins: 若领域会突发剧变(欺诈手法一夜改变)，固定节奏来不及，改用触发式在漂移越阈值时即时再训练。
optionExplanations: 对；稳定+渐进漂移正是调度式的甜区，固定节奏够用、成本可预测、无需养监控。
为渐进漂移养触发监控是过度工程，稳定域几乎不会突破阈值，白白增加复杂度。
搜索排序无需秒级即时，在线学习的抗噪与基建代价在这里不划算。
不再训练会让渐进漂移持续累积，排序质量悄悄下滑。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — stable plus gradual drift is scheduled's sweet spot: a fixed cadence suffices, cost is predictable, and no monitoring is needed.
Maintaining trigger monitoring for gradual drift is over-engineering; a stable domain rarely breaches the threshold, adding complexity for nothing.
Search ranking needs no second-level immediacy, so online learning's noise and infrastructure costs are not worth it here.
Not retraining lets gradual drift accumulate and quietly erodes ranking quality.

termDefinitions.term: scheduled retraining / 调度式再训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定节奏(每日/每周)再训练，不看信号，成本和编排可预测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scheduled retraining runs on a fixed cadence (daily/weekly) regardless of signals, with predictable cost and orchestration.

scenario: 一个欺诈检测模型，欺诈手法可能一夜之间突变，平时又长期平稳，团队想省算力但绝不能漏掉突发退化。
scenario_en: A fraud model where tactics can shift overnight but are otherwise stable for long stretches; the team wants to save compute but must not miss sudden degradation.
q: 该选哪种再训练策略？
q_en: Which retraining policy fits?
why: 触发式最贴合：平稳时不训省算力，一旦漂移信号越阈值就即时再训练，对突发欺诈手法即时响应。代价是必须养一套可靠监控，防误报浪费/漏报退化。
why_en: Trigger-based fits best: skip retraining when stable to save compute, but retrain immediately when the drift signal breaches, responding to sudden fraud shifts — at the cost of a robust monitor that avoids false alarms and missed triggers.
tradeoff: 触发式(省算力+即时响应突变) vs 调度式(简单但对突变滞后)
options: 调度式：固定每周再训练，不管欺诈是否突变
触发式：盯漂移信号，越阈值即时再训练，平稳时省算力
永不再训练，靠人工事后复盘
全离线季度再训练，攒够一季度数据才更新
options_en: Scheduled: retrain weekly regardless of whether fraud shifts.
Trigger-based: watch the drift signal, retrain immediately on breach, save compute when stable.
Never retrain, relying on manual post-mortems.
Fully offline quarterly retraining, updating only after a quarter of data.
whenOtherWins: 若领域稳定、漂移只是缓慢渐进(如搜索)，触发式的监控栈是过度投入，固定节奏的调度式更省心。
optionExplanations: 固定每周对突发欺诈太慢：手法一夜变了得等到下周才训，中间损失巨大。
对；高风险+突变正是触发式的甜区，平稳省算力、突变即时响应，恰好满足两个诉求。
不再训练意味着欺诈手法变了模型也不动，退化会持续放大。
季度再训练比每周还慢，突发欺诈场景完全不可接受。
optionExplanations_en: Weekly is too slow for sudden fraud: if tactics change overnight you wait until next week, losing heavily in between.
Correct — high-stakes plus sudden shifts is trigger-based's sweet spot: save compute when calm, respond instantly on a shift, meeting both needs.
Not retraining means the model stays put as fraud tactics change, and degradation keeps amplifying.
Quarterly is even slower than weekly and completely unacceptable for sudden fraud.

termDefinitions.term: trigger-based retraining / 触发式再训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 监控漂移信号，越过阈值才自动再训练；平稳期省算力，突变即时响应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trigger-based retraining monitors a drift signal and retrains only on threshold breach, saving compute when stable and responding instantly to shifts.

scenario: 一个大规模生产推荐系统，既要保证基线新鲜度，又要在突发分布变化时兜底，还要控制算力。
scenario_en: A large-scale production recommender that needs a freshness baseline, a safety net for sudden shifts, and compute control.
q: 多数大团队实际怎么组合再训练策略？
q_en: How do most large teams actually combine retraining policies?
why: 混合式：调度式提供固定新鲜度基线，触发式当突发漂移的紧急安全网。这样平时可预测、突变有兜底，代价是最复杂——要同时维护节奏和监控两套机制。
why_en: Hybrid: scheduled provides a freshness baseline and trigger-based acts as an emergency safety net for sudden drift, giving predictability plus a fallback at the cost of being the most complex to maintain.
tradeoff: 混合式(可预测+突变兜底) vs 单一策略(要么慢要么无基线)
options: 只用调度式，突变时靠运气熬到下个周期
只用触发式，完全不设固定节奏基线
调度式做固定新鲜度基线 + 触发式做突发漂移的紧急安全网，代价是最复杂
两套都不要，改用在线学习替代所有再训练
options_en: Scheduled only, riding out sudden shifts until the next cycle by luck.
Trigger-based only, with no fixed-cadence baseline at all.
Scheduled for a fixed freshness baseline plus trigger-based as an emergency safety net for sudden drift, at the cost of most complexity.
Neither, replacing all retraining with online learning.
whenOtherWins: 若团队小、系统简单或算力紧，维护两套机制不划算，退回单一调度式(稳定域)或单一触发式(突变域)即可。
optionExplanations: 只用调度式缺突变兜底，一旦分布剧变得硬等下个周期，生产系统承受不起。
只用触发式没有固定基线，平稳期也可能因监控盲区让新鲜度悄悄滑落。
对；大规模生产用混合式兼顾可预测新鲜度与突变响应，代价是同时养节奏+监控两套。
在线学习并不能替代所有再训练，很多上游重模块仍需周期性批量。
optionExplanations_en: Scheduled alone lacks a sudden-shift fallback; a distribution jump forces waiting for the next cycle, which production cannot afford.
Trigger alone has no fixed baseline, so even in calm periods a monitoring blind spot can quietly erode freshness.
Correct — large-scale production uses hybrid to balance predictable freshness with sudden-shift response, at the cost of maintaining both cadence and monitoring.
Online learning cannot replace all retraining; many heavy upstream modules still need periodic batch.

termDefinitions.term: hybrid retraining / 混合式再训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 调度式固定节奏做基线 + 触发式做突发漂移的紧急兜底，两者结合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid retraining combines a scheduled fixed-cadence baseline with trigger-based emergency retraining for sudden drift.

scenario: 用户看到的推荐来自多个模型版本混合，你要把每次用户行为归因到「真正导致这次展示的那次预测」。
scenario_en: Recommendations come from a mix of model versions, and you must attribute each user action to the exact prediction that caused that impression.
q: 为什么需要一个「信号路由层 (signal routing layer)」，它防的是什么？
q_en: Why do you need a signal routing layer, and what does it prevent?
why: 信号路由层把用户行为准确对齐到「引发它的那次预测」，否则把行为归错模型会引入选择偏差(selection bias)，让再训练学到失真的因果，指标看着动其实归因错了。
why_en: A signal routing layer aligns each user action to the prediction that caused it, otherwise mis-attributing actions introduces selection bias and retraining learns a distorted cause-effect.
options: 它是负载均衡器，只负责把请求平均分到各模型副本
它把用户行为准确对齐到引发它的那次预测，防止归因错误导致的选择偏差
它是缓存层，只为降低特征查询延迟
它是限流器，防止突发流量打垮训练管线
options_en: A load balancer that just spreads requests evenly across model replicas.
It aligns each user action to the prediction that caused it, preventing the selection bias from mis-attribution.
A cache layer that only lowers feature-lookup latency.
A rate limiter that stops traffic spikes from overwhelming the training pipeline.
optionExplanations: 负载均衡处理的是请求分发，跟把行为归因到正确预测这个数据正确性问题无关。
对；正确归因是干净训练数据的前提，错配会把别的模型的功过算到当前模型头上，引入选择偏差。
缓存降的是延迟，不解决行为-预测的归因对齐。
限流保护的是稳定性，不是训练标签的因果正确性。
optionExplanations_en: Load balancing handles request distribution and is unrelated to the data-correctness problem of attributing actions to the right prediction.
Correct — correct attribution is a precondition for clean training data; mis-matching credits another model's outcome to this one, introducing selection bias.
A cache lowers latency and does not solve action-to-prediction attribution.
Rate limiting protects stability, not the causal correctness of training labels.

termDefinitions.term: signal routing layer / 信号路由层
termDefinitions.meaning: 把每次用户行为对齐回引发它的那次预测，保证再训练标签归因正确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signal routing layer maps each user action back to the prediction that caused it, keeping retraining labels correctly attributed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练数据的采集/归因不代表真实分布，让模型学到失真的因果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Selection bias is when how training data is collected or attributed misrepresents the true distribution, teaching the model a distorted cause-effect.

q: 把 champion/challenger 让新模型上线前「跑关卡」的顺序排好：
q_en: Order the champion/challenger gauntlet a new model must pass before full rollout:
steps: 数据验证：检查 schema 与分布是否正常
模型验证：检查是否收敛、参数是否合理
性能验证：离线指标 vs 留出集(holdout)
流量切分：路由把 ~5% 流量给 challenger、95% 给 champion
指标比较与晋升：统计显著窗口内业务指标达标才晋升，否则丢弃
why: 顺序是先便宜后昂贵、先离线后在线：数据→模型→性能三道离线门把明显坏的挡掉，再用小流量切分做在线活体评估，最后按统计显著的业务指标决定晋升还是丢弃。
why_en: The order is cheap-before-expensive and offline-before-live: data, model, and performance gates screen out obvious failures, then a small traffic split does live evaluation, and finally statistically significant business metrics decide promotion or discard.
diagram:
flowchart TB D["数据验证"] --> M["模型验证"] M --> P["性能验证
离线 vs holdout"] P --> S["流量切分 ~5%"] S --> C["指标比较"] C -->|达标| Promote["晋升为 champion"] C -->|不达标| Discard["丢弃"]

termDefinitions.meaning: champion 是当前服务用户的模型，challenger 是待验证的新模型，需跑完验证关卡才可能晋升。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The champion is the model currently serving users; the challenger is a new model that must pass validation gates before it can be promoted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时留出、不参与训练的一部分数据，用来无偏评估模型离线性能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A holdout is data set aside from training, used to evaluate the model's offline performance without bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先把小比例流量导给新版本观察，安全后再全量，这里用于模型版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A canary release routes a small fraction of traffic to a new version to observe safely before full rollout, here applied to model versions.

scenario: 刚再训练出一个新模型，有人主张直接推给全量用户。
scenario_en: A freshly retrained model is ready, and someone argues for pushing it to all users at once.
q: 在 champion/challenger 框架里，champion 和 challenger 各扮演什么角色，为什么不能直接全量？
q_en: In champion/challenger, what roles do champion and challenger play, and why not push to all users?
why: champion 是当前服务全量用户的现役模型，challenger 是待验证的新模型，只吃一小片流量跑关卡。直接全量上新模型太鲁莽——万一训练数据有 bug，会一次性伤到所有用户。
why_en: The champion serves all users now while the challenger is the new model that only takes a small traffic slice to prove itself, because pushing a new model to everyone at once is reckless if its training data has a bug.
options: champion 是现役服务全量的模型，challenger 是只吃小流量待验证的新模型；直接全量太鲁莽，坏模型会一次伤全部用户
champion 和 challenger 都服务全量流量，只是用不同硬件
challenger 服务全量、champion 只做离线基线，直接全量没风险
两者随机轮流服务同一批用户，无需验证关卡
options_en: The champion serves all users; the challenger is the new model on a small slice to prove itself, because full rollout is reckless and a bad model hurts everyone at once.
Both champion and challenger serve full traffic, just on different hardware.
The challenger serves full traffic while the champion is only an offline baseline, so full rollout has no risk.
They randomly alternate serving the same users with no validation gates.
optionExplanations: 对；champion 现役、challenger 小流量验证，这个角色分工正是为了不让未验证的新模型一次波及全量。
两者不同时服务全量：challenger 只吃约 5%，这是控制风险的核心。
说反了：challenger 是待验证的那个，只吃小流量；直接全量恰恰有风险。
不是随机轮流，challenger 要先过数据/模型/性能关卡再小流量评估。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the champion serves now and the challenger validates on a small slice, a split designed to keep an unproven model from hitting everyone at once.
They do not both serve full traffic: the challenger takes only about 5%, which is the core of risk control.
Backwards: the challenger is the one under validation and takes only a small slice; full rollout is exactly what carries risk.
It is not random alternation; the challenger must pass data/model/performance gates before small-traffic evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当前正在服务全量用户的现役模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The champion is the incumbent model currently serving all users.

termDefinitions.meaning: 待验证的新模型，先跑验证关卡再吃小流量活体评估。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The challenger is a new model that passes validation gates then takes a small traffic slice for live evaluation.

scenario: challenger 模型上线活体评估，路由把大约 5% 流量给它、95% 给 champion。
scenario_en: A challenger goes to live evaluation with the router sending about 5% of traffic to it and 95% to the champion.
q: 这个 5% 的切分比例对评估设计意味着什么？
q_en: What does this 5% split imply for the evaluation design?
why: 5% 是金丝雀发布式的经验比例、不是公式推导：小到坏模型也只伤 5% 用户(限爆炸半径)，又要足够大和足够长的窗口才能凑够统计显著的业务指标；太小则样本不足、迟迟判不出胜负。
why_en: The 5% is an empirical canary fraction, not a formula: small enough that a bad model hurts only 5% of users, yet the window must be large and long enough to reach statistically significant business metrics.
options: 5% 是硬性数学最优，任何系统都必须精确用 5%，不能调
5% 说明 challenger 已经证明更好，可以省掉指标比较
5% 越小越好，哪怕只有 0.01% 也能立刻判出胜负
5% 是金丝雀式经验比例：坏模型只伤 5% 用户限爆炸半径，同时窗口要够大够久才能凑够统计显著的业务指标
options_en: 5% is a hard mathematical optimum every system must use exactly and cannot tune.
5% means the challenger is already proven better, so metric comparison can be skipped.
The smaller the better, even 0.01% instantly decides the winner.
5% is an empirical canary fraction: a bad model hurts only 5% of users to bound blast radius, while the window must be large and long enough for statistically significant business metrics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 路由把一小比例流量导给新模型做活体对照评估，其余仍走现役模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Traffic splitting routes a small fraction of traffic to the new model for a live controlled comparison, with the rest on the incumbent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 指标差异大到不太可能只是随机波动，需要足够样本量和观察窗口才能判定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Statistical significance means a metric difference is unlikely to be random noise, requiring enough sample size and observation window.

scenario: 评估 challenger 时，有人建议给 champion 用工作日流量、给 challenger 用周末流量以省事。
scenario_en: During evaluation, someone suggests measuring the champion on weekday traffic and the challenger on weekend traffic for convenience.
q: 为什么 champion 和 challenger 必须看「同一片流量切分」？
q_en: Why must champion and challenger see the same traffic slice?
why: 只有同一片流量(同时段、同人群)对照，指标差异才归因于模型本身；工作日 vs 周末的人群/行为不同，会把流量差异误当成模型差异，引入选择偏差让结论作废。
why_en: Only comparing on the same slice (same time, same population) attributes metric differences to the model itself, since weekday-versus-weekend populations differ and would inject selection bias that invalidates the conclusion.
tradeoff: 同一片流量对照(干净归因) vs 不同时段/人群(混入选择偏差)
options: 为了省算力，让两个模型分别在不同时段跑
同一片流量对照才能把指标差异归因到模型本身，否则工作日/周末的人群差异会混入选择偏差、结论作废
无所谓看哪片流量，只要样本量一样大就行
必须让 challenger 看更难的流量，才算真正的压力测试
options_en: To save compute, run the two models in different time windows.
Only the same slice attributes metric differences to the model, otherwise weekday/weekend population differences inject selection bias and void the conclusion.
It doesn't matter which slice, as long as the sample sizes are equal.
The challenger must see harder traffic to count as a real stress test.
whenOtherWins: 只有当你专门想测某个特定分段(如仅新用户)时，才刻意固定到那一段，但两模型仍须在同一段上对照。
optionExplanations: 省算力换来的是脏对照：不同时段人群不同，指标差异分不清是模型还是流量造成的。
对；同片流量把外部变量对齐，剩下的差异才是模型本身，这是避免选择偏差的关键。
样本量相等还不够——若两片流量人群不同，偏差仍在，必须是同一片。
让 challenger 单独看更难流量会人为拉低它，评估不公平也不干净。
optionExplanations_en: Saving compute buys a dirty comparison: different time windows have different populations, so the metric gap cannot be told apart from a traffic effect.
Correct — the same slice aligns external variables so the remaining difference is the model itself, the key to avoiding selection bias.
Equal sample size is not enough — if the two slices have different populations the bias remains; it must be the same slice.
Giving the challenger harder traffic artificially penalizes it, making the evaluation unfair and dirty.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一时段、同一人群的一批请求，用于给两个模型做同条件对照。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A traffic slice is a batch of requests from the same time and population, used to compare two models under identical conditions.

scenario: Uber 的 ETA challenger 在 5% 的行程上跑，结果发现它的训练数据被一个管线 bug 污染了。
scenario_en: Uber's ETA challenger runs on 5% of rides, and it turns out its training data was corrupted by a pipeline bug.
q: champion/challenger 的小流量评估在这里带来了什么价值？
q_en: What value did the small-traffic champion/challenger evaluation provide here?
why: 小流量金丝雀把坏模型的影响圈在 5% 内并及早暴露：污染训练数据的 challenger 直接被丢弃、champion 继续服务，全量用户几乎无感。若直接全量上线，这个 bug 会波及所有行程。
why_en: The small-traffic canary contained the bad model to 5% and surfaced it early: the corrupted challenger was discarded and the champion kept serving with no user impact, whereas a full rollout would have hit every ride.
options: 它证明所有 challenger 都会失败，不该再训练模型
它把坏模型影响圈在 5% 并及早暴露：污染的 challenger 被丢弃、champion 继续服务，全量用户无感
它加快了 challenger 的训练速度，与风险无关
它自动修复了被污染的训练数据，无需人工介入
options_en: It proves all challengers fail and models should not be retrained.
It contained the bad model to 5% and surfaced it early: the corrupted challenger was discarded, the champion kept serving, and users felt nothing.
It sped up the challenger's training, unrelated to risk.
It automatically fixed the corrupted training data with no human intervention.
optionExplanations: 过度推论：challenger 失败不代表不该再训练，正是这套机制让失败变得安全、可继续迭代。
对；金丝雀的价值就是限爆炸半径+早发现，坏 challenger 只伤 5% 就被拦下，champion 兜底。
小流量评估不是为了加速训练，而是控风险、做在线活体验证。
它只是暴露并丢弃坏模型，不会自动修复被污染的数据，那仍需人工排查。
optionExplanations_en: Over-reach: a failed challenger does not mean stop retraining; this very mechanism makes failure safe so you can keep iterating.
Correct — the canary's value is bounding blast radius plus early detection: the bad challenger hurt only 5% before being stopped, with the champion as fallback.
Small-traffic evaluation is not for speeding training but for risk control and live validation.
It only exposes and discards the bad model; it does not auto-fix corrupted data, which still needs manual investigation.

scenario: 面试官问：「你的模型上线后为什么会随时间退化？先说最常见的那个原因。」
scenario_en: Interviewer: 'Why does your model degrade over time in production? Lead with the most common cause.'
q: 生产模型退化最常见的根因是什么，它常常比架构选择的影响更大？
q_en: What is the most common root cause of production model degradation, often bigger than architecture choices?
why: 训练-服务偏差(training-serving skew)：训练时的分布/特征计算和服务时模型实际看到的不一致，是退化的头号原因，往往比模型架构选得好不好影响更大。面试先讲它再讲缓解手段。
why_en: Training-serving skew — a divergence between the training distribution/feature computation and what the model actually sees at serving — is the top cause of degradation, often outweighing architecture choices.
options: 训练-服务偏差：训练分布/特征计算与服务时不一致，是退化头号根因，常大于架构选择
GPU 显存不足导致推理精度下降
模型参数量太小，加大模型即可根治退化
网络延迟抖动，是退化的最主要原因
options_en: Training-serving skew: the training distribution/feature computation diverges from serving, the top cause, often bigger than architecture.
Insufficient GPU memory lowering inference precision.
Too few parameters; enlarging the model cures degradation.
Network latency jitter as the main cause of degradation.
optionExplanations: 对；训练时与服务时的分布/特征不一致是退化头号原因，面试应先点它再讲缓解。
显存不足是工程故障，不是模型随时间退化的分布性根因。
加大模型改善的是容量，压不住世界变化带来的分布漂移。
网络抖动影响延迟不影响模型学到的分布，与退化根因无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a train-vs-serve mismatch in distribution/features is the top cause of degradation; lead with it, then mitigations.
GPU memory shortage is an engineering fault, not the distributional root cause of degradation over time.
Enlarging the model boosts capacity but cannot hold back distribution drift from a changing world.
Network jitter affects latency, not the learned distribution, and is unrelated to the degradation root cause.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时的数据分布或特征计算方式与线上服务时不一致，是模型退化最常见根因。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is a divergence between the training distribution or feature computation and what the model sees at serving, the most common cause of degradation.

scenario: 训练时某特征是「7 天滚动平均」，离线批算；线上服务时同名特征却是「当前时点查一次」，两边计算逻辑不同。
scenario_en: In training a feature is a 7-day rolling average computed in batch, but at serving the same-named feature is a single point-in-time lookup — two different computations.
q: 这属于哪种训练-服务偏差，最直接的缓解是什么？
q_en: Which kind of training-serving skew is this, and what is the most direct mitigation?
why: 这是数据管线偏差(pipeline skew)：同一特征两边算法不同。最直接的解法是统一特征仓库(feature store)，让训练和服务共用同一套计算逻辑，从源头消除不一致。
why_en: This is data-pipeline skew — the same feature computed differently on each side — and the most direct fix is a unified feature store so training and serving share one computation logic.
tradeoff: 统一特征仓库(消除双端不一致但要建平台) vs 两端各自实现(快但持续漂移)
options: 标签反馈延迟；用代理标签缓解
数据管线偏差；用统一特征仓库让训练/服务共用同一套计算逻辑
概念漂移；用触发式再训练缓解
数据漂移；靠加大模型容量缓解
options_en: Label feedback delay; mitigate with proxy labels.
Data-pipeline skew; use a unified feature store so training and serving share one computation logic.
Concept drift; mitigate with trigger-based retraining.
Data drift; mitigate by increasing model capacity.
whenOtherWins: 若两端算法一致、只是标签迟到才失准，那是标签延迟问题，该上代理标签+缩短再训练周期，而非特征仓库。
optionExplanations: 标签延迟是标签迟到，本题问题在特征两端算法不同，不是标签时效。
对；同名特征两端算法不一致是典型管线偏差，统一特征仓库共用一套逻辑正是对症。
概念漂移是 P(Y|X) 变了，本题是特征计算不一致，不是映射关系变化。
数据漂移是输入分布随时间变，本题是同一时刻两端算法不同，加大模型无关。
optionExplanations_en: Label delay is labels arriving late; here the problem is two different feature computations, not label timeliness.
Correct — the same feature computed differently on each side is classic pipeline skew, and a unified feature store sharing one logic is the direct fix.
Concept drift is P(Y|X) changing; here it is inconsistent feature computation, not a changed mapping.
Data drift is inputs shifting over time; here the two sides differ at the same instant, and model size is irrelevant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一管理特征定义与计算的平台，让训练与服务共用同一套逻辑，消除双端偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store centralizes feature definitions and computation so training and serving share one logic, eliminating skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取某一时刻的特征值，须避免用到未来信息造成泄漏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point-in-time lookup fetches a feature value as of a specific moment, avoiding leakage from future information.

scenario: 欺诈标签要等确认，常常 +30 天才到；等真标签再训练，模型早已落后于最新欺诈手法。
scenario_en: Fraud labels take about +30 days to confirm; waiting for true labels to retrain leaves the model behind the latest tactics.
q: 这属于哪种训练-服务偏差，怎么缓解？
q_en: Which kind of training-serving skew is this, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 这是标签反馈延迟(label feedback delay)：真标签数天/数周才到。缓解用代理标签(proxy label)——找更快到达的替身信号顶上，再配合缩短再训练周期，让模型不必干等真标签。
why_en: This is label feedback delay — true labels arrive days or weeks late — mitigated with proxy labels (faster-arriving stand-ins) plus a shorter retraining cadence so the model does not wait idle.
tradeoff: 代理标签(快但可能偏) vs 只等真标签(准但严重滞后)
options: 数据管线偏差；用统一特征仓库缓解
标签反馈延迟；用更快到达的代理标签顶上 + 缩短再训练周期
数据漂移；用 PSI 监控输入分布缓解
概念漂移；靠加大 batch size 缓解
options_en: Data-pipeline skew; mitigate with a unified feature store.
Label feedback delay; use faster-arriving proxy labels plus a shorter retraining cadence.
Data drift; mitigate by monitoring input distribution with PSI.
Concept drift; mitigate by increasing batch size.
whenOtherWins: 若真标签其实很快就到、只是两端特征算法不同才失准，那是管线偏差，该上统一特征仓库而非代理标签。
optionExplanations: 管线偏差是特征两端算法不同，本题瓶颈是标签迟到，不是特征计算。
对；标签迟到就用代理标签当快速替身，再缩短周期，让模型不必等 30 天真标签。
PSI 查的是输入分布漂移，解决不了「标签迟到没法训练」这个时效问题。
加大 batch size 与标签何时到达无关，救不了标签延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Pipeline skew is different feature computation on each side; here the bottleneck is late labels, not feature computation.
Correct — for late labels use proxy labels as fast stand-ins plus a shorter cadence so the model need not wait 30 days for true labels.
PSI checks input-distribution drift and cannot solve the timing problem of labels arriving too late to train on.
Increasing batch size is unrelated to when labels arrive and does not fix label delay.

termDefinitions.meaning: 比真标签更快到达的替身信号，用来在真标签到位前支撑训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy label is a faster-arriving stand-in signal used to support training before the true label is available.

termDefinitions.term: label feedback delay / 标签反馈延迟
termDefinitions.meaning: 真实标签要数天/数周后才确认到达，拖慢再训练时效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Label feedback delay is when true labels only confirm days or weeks later, slowing retraining.

scenario: 面试官特意问你区分：一种是输入分布变了，另一种是同样的输入现在对应不同的意图/结果。
scenario_en: The interviewer specifically asks you to distinguish: one is inputs shifting, the other is the same input now mapping to a different intent/outcome.
q: 数据漂移 (data drift) 和概念漂移 (concept drift) 的区别是什么？
q_en: What is the difference between data drift and concept drift?
why: 数据漂移是输入分布 P(X) 变了、但输入→输出映射未必变(夏转秋的流量)；概念漂移是特征看着一样、但映射 P(Y|X) 变了(同样的用户/广告在 UI 改版后 CTR 骤降)。很多候选人把两者混为一谈。
why_en: Data drift is the input distribution P(X) shifting while the input-to-output mapping may stay put, whereas concept drift is the mapping P(Y|X) changing even though features look the same.
tradeoff: 数据漂移(输入变、映射未必变) vs 概念漂移(输入同、映射变)

rows: UI 改版后同用户 CTR 骤降

options: 数据漂移是模型权重变了，概念漂移是数据库 schema 变了
两者是同义词，只是叫法不同
数据漂移是输入分布 P(X) 变、映射未必变；概念漂移是输入看着一样但映射 P(Y·X) 变了
数据漂移只发生在训练，概念漂移只发生在推理，二者不会共存
options_en: Data drift means the model weights changed; concept drift means the database schema changed.
They are synonyms with different names.
Data drift is the input distribution P(X) shifting with the mapping maybe unchanged; concept drift is the same-looking input but the mapping P(Y|X) changed.
Data drift only happens in training and concept drift only in inference, and they never coexist.
optionExplanations: 全错：漂移讲的是数据/映射随时间变，不是权重变或 schema 变。
不是同义词——一个是输入变、一个是映射变，检测手段也不同，混淆正是常见失分点。
对；P(X) 变 vs P(Y·X) 变是本质区别，前者查输入分布、后者查预测误差/校准。
两者都发生在生产分布随时间变，且完全可以同时发生，不受训练/推理阶段限制。
optionExplanations_en: All wrong: drift is about data/mapping changing over time, not weights or schema changing.
Not synonyms — one is inputs shifting, the other is the mapping shifting, detected differently, and conflating them is a common way to lose points.
Correct — P(X) shifting versus P(Y|X) shifting is the essential difference: check input distribution for one, prediction error/calibration for the other.
Both occur as the production distribution changes over time and can happen simultaneously, not confined to training or inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入分布 P(X) 随时间变化，输入到输出的映射未必变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data drift is the input distribution P(X) changing over time, while the input-to-output mapping may stay the same.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征看着一样，但输入到标签的映射 P(Y|X) 变了，同样行为现在含义不同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is when features look the same but the input-to-label mapping P(Y|X) changed, so the same behavior now means something different.

scenario: 线上输入分布随时间持续变化(用户构成、内容类型都在漂),模型准确率缓慢下滑但没有明确故障。
scenario_en: The live input distribution keeps shifting over time (user mix, content types drift) and accuracy slowly slides with no hard failure.
q: 针对这种分布漂移，最合适的缓解组合是什么？
q_en: What is the most fitting mitigation for this distribution shift?
why: 分布漂移的对策是漂移监控 + 触发式再训练：持续监控输入(数据漂移)和映射(概念漂移)信号，一旦越阈值就自动再训练，把模型拉回当前分布，而不是干等固定周期。
why_en: The remedy for distribution shift is drift monitoring plus trigger-based retraining: continuously watch input and mapping signals and auto-retrain on breach to pull the model back to the current distribution.
tradeoff: 漂移监控+触发再训练(对症、及时) vs 只加大模型(治不了分布变化)
options: 加大模型容量，让它记住更多模式
统一特征仓库，消除两端特征计算差异
漂移监控 + 触发式再训练：监控输入/映射信号，越阈值即自动再训练把模型拉回当前分布
换更快的推理硬件，降低服务延迟
options_en: Increase model capacity so it memorizes more patterns.
A unified feature store to remove feature-computation differences between the two sides.
Drift monitoring plus trigger-based retraining: watch input/mapping signals and auto-retrain on breach to pull the model back to the current distribution.
Switch to faster inference hardware to cut serving latency.
whenOtherWins: 若失准其实来自训练/服务特征算法不一致(而非世界变化)，那是管线偏差，该上统一特征仓库而不是再训练。
optionExplanations: 加大模型提升的是容量，抵不过世界持续变化带来的分布漂移，治标不治本。
特征仓库治的是两端计算不一致，不是输入分布随时间真实变化。
对；漂移监控发现变化、触发再训练把模型对齐到当前分布，是分布漂移的对症组合。
换硬件只降延迟，与输入分布是否变化毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: More capacity cannot outrun a continuously changing world's distribution drift, treating symptoms not cause.
A feature store fixes inconsistent computation on the two sides, not a genuine input-distribution change over time.
Correct — monitoring detects the change and trigger-based retraining realigns the model to the current distribution, the on-target combo for drift.
New hardware only lowers latency and has nothing to do with whether the input distribution shifts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上输入随时间变化，涵盖数据漂移(输入变)与概念漂移(映射变)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distribution shift is live inputs changing over time, covering both data drift (inputs) and concept drift (mapping).

scenario: 复习训练-服务偏差的三大来源及各自缓解手段。
scenario_en: Review the three sources of training-serving skew and each mitigation.
q: 补全训练-服务偏差的三个来源与对应缓解：
q_en: Fill in the three sources of training-serving skew and their mitigations:
text: 训练-服务偏差三来源：①{{数据管线}}偏差(特征两端算法不同)→统一{{特征仓库}}；②{{标签}}反馈延迟(真标签数周才到)→{{代理}}标签+缩短周期；③{{分布}}漂移(输入或映射随时间变)→漂移监控+{{触发式}}再训练。
text_en: Three sources of training-serving skew: (1) {{data-pipeline}} skew (feature computed differently) → unified {{feature store}}; (2) {{label}} feedback delay (true labels weeks late) → {{proxy}} labels + shorter cadence; (3) {{distribution}} shift (inputs or mapping change over time) → drift monitoring + {{trigger-based}} retraining.
why: 三来源各有对症解法：管线偏差→特征仓库统一计算；标签延迟→代理标签补位；分布漂移→监控+触发再训练。面试答退化时按这个结构走一遍最稳。
why_en: Each source has its own fix: pipeline skew to a feature store, label delay to proxy labels, distribution shift to monitoring plus trigger-based retraining.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练与服务在特征/分布/标签时效上的不一致，退化的头号根因，有三大来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is train-vs-serve inconsistency in features, distribution, or label timing — the top cause of degradation, with three sources.

q: 面试被问「你的模型如何随时间退化」，把最稳的作答结构排好：
q_en: Asked 'how does your model degrade over time,' order the strongest answer structure:
steps: 先点名头号根因：训练-服务偏差
拆成三来源：管线偏差、标签延迟、分布漂移(数据/概念)
给每个来源配缓解：特征仓库、代理标签、漂移监控
落到再训练策略：调度/触发/混合把模型持续拉回当前分布
why: 先亮最重要的根因(训练-服务偏差)抓住重点，再拆三来源展示全面，接着落到再训练策略和逐项缓解，体现从诊断到治理的闭环——这是 Staff+ 想听的结构。
why_en: Lead with the top root cause (training-serving skew) to anchor, decompose the three sources to show breadth, then land on retraining policy and per-source mitigations, showing a diagnose-to-remedy loop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在退化或故障时退回可用的次优路径(如兜底启发式)，而非彻底崩溃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graceful degradation is falling back to a usable suboptimal path (e.g. a fallback heuristic) when degrading or failing, instead of collapsing.

scenario: Google 广告排序若对一次爆红的新品慢 24 小时才适应，就等于错过了一整天的优化投放。
scenario_en: If Google ad ranking adapts to a viral product launch 24 hours late, that equals a full day of lost optimized placements.
q: 「24 小时滞后 = 损失一天优化投放」这个说法在设计上意味着什么？
q_en: What does '24h lag equals a lost day of optimized placements' imply for design?
why: 陈旧代价不是抽象损失、而是直接折成收入：模型每晚 T 小时适应，就少赚 T 小时的最优投放。它把「新鲜度」量化成收入基数，用来论证在广告这类场景值得付出在线学习的基建复杂度。
why_en: Staleness cost converts directly into revenue: every hour late is an hour of suboptimal placement lost, which quantifies freshness as a revenue base justifying online learning's infra complexity here.
options: 说明广告排序无需实时，慢一天完全可以接受
说明只要买更多服务器就能消除滞后，与学习方式无关
24 小时是硬性 SLA，任何模型都必须在 24 小时内更新
陈旧代价直接折成收入(每滞后 1 小时 = 少赚 1 小时最优投放)，把新鲜度量化成收入基数，论证值得上在线学习的基建
options_en: It shows ad ranking needs no real-time and a day late is fine.
It shows buying more servers eliminates the lag, unrelated to the learning method.
24h is a hard SLA every model must update within.
Staleness cost converts directly into revenue (each hour late loses an hour of optimal placement), quantifying freshness as a revenue base that justifies online learning's infra.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型落后于当前分布每单位时间造成的业务损失(此处是广告收入)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staleness cost is the business loss (here ad revenue) per unit time the model lags behind the current distribution.

scenario: 面试官问你在持续学习里到底在权衡什么，想听一句能收住全场的核心取舍。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what you are fundamentally trading off in continual learning and wants one closing axis.
q: 持续学习(在线/周期再训练/champion-challenger/偏差治理)背后统一的核心取舍轴是什么？
q_en: What single core tradeoff axis unifies continual learning (online / retraining / champion-challenger / skew control)?
why: 核心轴是新鲜度 vs 稳定性：在线学习和频繁再训练买新鲜度(快速适应变化)，批量、champion/challenger 验证和 KL 式约束买稳定性(防噪声/操纵/坏更新)。所有具体机制都是在这条轴上找平衡点。
why_en: The core axis is freshness versus stability: online learning and frequent retraining buy freshness while batch, champion/challenger validation, and constraints buy stability, and every mechanism balances on this axis.
tradeoff: 新鲜度(快速适应变化) vs 稳定性(防噪声/操纵/坏更新)
options: 新鲜度 vs 稳定性：即时适应世界变化 对抗 防噪声/操纵/坏更新，所有机制都在这条轴上找平衡
精度 vs 召回：只是分类阈值的取舍
内存 vs 磁盘：纯粹的存储成本取舍
读性能 vs 写性能：数据库层面的取舍
options_en: Freshness vs stability: adapting instantly to a changing world versus guarding against noise/gaming/bad updates, the axis every mechanism balances on.
Precision vs recall: just a classification-threshold tradeoff.
Memory vs disk: purely a storage-cost tradeoff.
Read vs write performance: a database-level tradeoff.
whenOtherWins: 当任务标签慢、易被操纵或坏更新代价高时，天平压向稳定性(批量+严格验证)；标签快、变化剧烈且影响面有界时压向新鲜度(在线学习)。
optionExplanations: 对；新鲜度 vs 稳定性把在线学习、再训练策略、champion/challenger 全串成一条主线，是本课的收束句。
精度/召回是单模型评估的取舍，不是持续学习的系统级主轴。
内存/磁盘是存储成本问题，与持续学习要不要快速适应变化无关。
读写性能是数据库层取舍，答不到持续学习的核心矛盾。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — freshness vs stability threads online learning, retraining policy, and champion/challenger into one line, the lesson's closing statement.
Precision/recall is a single-model evaluation tradeoff, not the system-level axis of continual learning.
Memory/disk is a storage-cost question, unrelated to whether continual learning should adapt fast.
Read/write performance is a database-layer tradeoff and misses continual learning's core tension.
